title: 26th Sunday in Ordinary Time – A Call to Faithful Compassion & Stewardship
summary:
In this week's reflection for the Twenty-Sixth Sunday in Ordinary Time, Holy Trinity Parish calls our community to open our hearts and hands in renewed compassion for those who are struggling. Drawing upon the Sunday readings, we are reminded that genuine Christian discipleship is expressed through attentive love for the marginalized and faithful stewardship of the gifts entrusted to us. As a parish family, we are invited to reflect on how our everyday choices can bring Christ's solace and hope to our neighbours in need.

Key parish announcements highlight upcoming ministry initiatives across Holy Trinity and our SALLTO pastoral cluster. The Society of St. Vincent de Paul will be conducting their monthly food collection this weekend, and volunteers are warmly welcomed for the community soup kitchen. Additionally, registration remains open for the upcoming sacramental preparation programs and the parish ministry fair scheduled after all morning Masses.
